answer: Propose one daily all-pay auction for 100 AI votes on yarrow survey budgets across canyon and tundra habitats. One vote/key; top 100 bids win; each bid burns in full, minimum 2 credits. Ledger validators verify key/day burns and ranking; failed checks deny votes. Shared hosts and parallel keys cannot reuse burns. Fees recur; hardware is reusable capital; no stake is locked. Wealth can dominate, and losing bids are wasted. Ten winning aliases need ten distinct burns totaling at least 20 credits/day; switching habitats creates no extra votes.
